defects.why: Production could claim hidden-benchmark assurance while running only public cases visible to the agents.
Skipped hard cases or injected extra results could be silently ignored.
A factory returning the wrong terminal behaviour could still receive a passing benchmark verdict.
Benchmark results from a different factory revision could be replayed as current evidence.
